title: anthoxanthum odoratum var. puelii
intro: Anthoxanthum odoratum var. puelii, commonly known as sweet vernal grass or vernal grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing respiratory issues, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of sweet vernal grass include acting as an expectorant to help relieve coughs and congestion, as well as exhibiting anti-anaphylactic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of sweet vernal grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
